records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone; only Wrenfield-side contact (email:c4e368c3) with no customer reply. One invite sent shows some intent, but no self-driven setup progress and no tickets suggests low engagement; 8 days left leaves modest room for unaided activation.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield?
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. I see an invite has already gone out to a teammate — nice start. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if that's helpful.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
